digest.component_or_area: event-schema documentation and graph relations contract
propositions: docs/event-schema.md lists six canonical LINK relations but omits the supported caused_by relation, which is the seventh canonical relation defined in src/rebar/graph/_links.py

the documentation omission occurred because the relation inventory is manually duplicated: commit 901241b218 added caused_by to CANONICAL_RELATIONS and related surfaces but did not update docs/event-schema.md, then commit 693a6bf412 rewrote the LINK/UNLINK row and retained the stale six-value list
the caused_by relation is directional, non-blocking, and non-cycle-inducing according to both the closed design authority isogonal-wedged-catfish and existing documentation in docs/ticket-model.md
a documentation contract test must parse the event-schema LINK/UNLINK row and enforce set equality with CANONICAL_RELATIONS to prevent future relation omissions

the repair adds caused_by to the event-schema documentation inventory and includes explicit semantics (directional, non-blocking, non-cycle-inducing) plus a deterministic contract test that was RED before repair with sole missing relation caused_by
